stories.title: Iran says US strike killed five at a wedding as CENTCOM investigates
stories.reason: Iranian officials say a US strike hit a home hosting a wedding in Sirik, killing five including a child and wounding 68, a claim CENTCOM says it is investigating rather than denying outright -- a flashpoint that could harden the six-month war further.

stories.title: DRC Ebola outbreak becomes deadliest in the country's history, death toll tops 3,000
stories.reason: More than 6,000 confirmed cases and over 3,000 deaths make this the worst Ebola epidemic on record, prompting the WHO to declare it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

stories.title: Trump administration backs OpenAI's fair-use defense in New York Times copyright case
stories.reason: It's the first time the US government has weighed in on the wave of AI-training copyright lawsuits, arguing fair use on national-security and competitiveness grounds -- a major signal for every AI lab facing similar suits.

stories.title: OpenAI says its Astra model is the first to cross the 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold
stories.reason: Astra scored a perfect 100% on ExploitBench and autonomously chained together two previously unknown zero-days, prompting OpenAI to restrict access to its cybersecurity capabilities before any public release.

stories.title: NYC, the nation's largest school district, bans AI for students through 8th grade
stories.reason: The one-year moratorium affects nearly 600,000 students and blocks ChatGPT and Claude alike, making it the most expansive classroom AI ban in the country as officials weigh screen-time and cognitive-development concerns.

stories.title: Uber to cut 3,300 jobs, redirecting spending toward robotaxis
stories.reason: The 10% workforce cut -- Uber's largest since the pandemic -- funds a $10 billion-plus push into autonomous vehicles as CEO Dara Khosrowshahi reshapes the company for a driverless future.

stories.title: Texas freezes new data-center grid connections as 'ghost demand' hits 474 gigawatts
stories.reason: Governor Abbott's freeze puts roughly a fifth of the entire US data-center pipeline at risk of delay, an early sign that the AI industry's infrastructure buildout is colliding with real grid limits.

stories.title: Stocks rebound as oil rally stalls and a Fed official tempers rate-hike bets
stories.reason: The Dow rose 0.8% and the S&P 500 climbed 0.6%, clawing back part of Tuesday's 419-point drop as crude pulled off its highs even with the Iran conflict still unresolved.
